raw_cause: Native zone_s3_host.issue(hold) calls CameraRobotPort.hold, cancelling newly queued arm/pan before tick. Robot own-command target retains the cancelled target.
change: For normal open-gripper mapping/align only, dispatch hold as existing wait: stop wheels while retaining camera targets. Emergency hold and grasp/carry phases unchanged.

tests.scope: Actual native port issue/tick with spies; no physics/model calls

research.adaptation: Keep independent actuator trajectory active unless explicitly cancelled; use existing wheel-only wait. No joint feedback introduced.
Distinguish waiting action from cancellation; no external ROS dependency.
